limits: This is a narrow static source review, not the complete lifecycle or original adapter review.
No local controls, device requests, UI interaction, namespace operation or Android runtime were executed for this review.
Final nonce literal values were not reviewed as execution authorization; the frozen module SHA binds the reviewed version for later comparison.
Actual target, click acknowledgement, playback, audio and cleanup remain independently required device evidence.
observations: Selection derives its exact title, same-card uploader and duration from the current inspection, requires a unique direct parent, and verifies that parent belongs to the current result pager. No historical node path, rank or coordinate authorizes the target.

CourseContract re-evaluates this selection in the actual Session action-bound inspection; the original contract object is restored in finally. The stable read preceding it cannot by itself authorize a later target.

The run path calls course_sequence at most once. A failed action is recorded before a separately fresh read-only observation; no click retry is introduced. The original error is retained through prior.remember.
Post-click acknowledgement is joined with the action-bound tree/window digests. The module leaves business outcome unknown and explicitly declines to infer playback or audio success.
